prompt: How does one Compose file make an AI application easier to inspect? Evidence run 20260923-151008.

fresh.answer: Using a Compose file for orchestrating Aspire AppHost services can enhance inspection by providing a clear definition of service dependencies, startup order, and endpoints, as stated in [1]. Additionally, passing connection information through Service references (WithReference) and delaying startup (WaitFor) until dependencies are ready can simplify the troubleshooting process [2]. Lastly, vector search capabilities of Qdrant for finding relevant grounding passages can aid in the model'success evaluation [3].
